skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Arrow Combo: 2 combos, dealing 240% ATK(+10) to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Knuckle High: 3 consecutive strikes to the enemy target column for 900% ATK(+9). Each strike adds 600% ATK as [True DMG]. Each strike can trigger [Specialized Evolve] once. [True DMG]: not affected by DMG increase/mitigation, unavoidable and unshareable, deals direct DMG to HP. [Specialized Evolve]: immediately cancels the target's Unyielding and DMG-ignore statuses.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Knuckle High (upgraded): 3 consecutive strikes to the enemy target column for 900% > 1200% ATK(+9). Each strike adds 600% > 840% ATK as [True DMG]. Each strike can trigger [Specialized Evolve] once. [True DMG]: not affected by DMG increase/mitigation, unavoidable and unshareable, deals direct DMG to HP. [Specialized Evolve]: immediately cancels the target's Unyielding and DMG-ignore statuses.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Focused Rage: Permanently +20 HP. Gain 60% [Specialized Evasion]. After any character's action, if cumulative DMG taken exceeds your Max HP, unleash [Wild Follow-up] dealing 180% of Ultimate Skill Power (ignores extra Energy cost, prioritizes front row), up to 10 times per battle. [Specialized Evasion]: reduce all Direct DMG/DoT/Injury/Extra DMG to just 1 point.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Focused Rage (upgraded): Permanently +20 HP. Gain 60% > 70% [Specialized Evasion]. After any character's action, if cumulative DMG taken exceeds your Max HP, unleash [Wild Follow-up] dealing 180% of Ultimate Skill Power (ignores extra Energy cost, prioritizes front row), up to 10 > 11 times per battle. [Specialized Evasion]: reduce all Direct DMG/DoT/Injury/Extra DMG to just 1 point.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Focused Rage (5P): Permanently +20 HP. Gain 60% > 80% [Specialized Evasion]. After any character's action, if cumulative DMG taken exceeds your Max HP, unleash [Wild Follow-up] dealing 180% of Ultimate Skill Power (ignores extra Energy cost, prioritizes front row), up to 10 > 12 times per battle. [Specialized Evasion]: reduce all Direct DMG/DoT/Injury/Extra DMG to just 1 point.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: Grants himself [Refresh]. Grants all allies 150% > 200% [Injury DMG Free]. [Refresh]: after being defeated, return to battle with 80% > 100% HP and increase own ATK by 20% for 1 round, up to 7 > 10 times. [Injury DMG Free]: reduce [Injury], [Internal Injury], and [Charge] DMG.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Injury DMG Free 150% > 200% Revive HP 80% > 100% Own ATK Increase 7x > 10x

effects.desc: Revive effect: after being defeated, return to the battle with 80% Health and gain +20% ST for 1 turn, up to 7 times.
Effect reduces Injury, Internal Injury and Cumulative damage taken.
Evasion PvP tier — reduces specialized attacks to 1 damage; pierced by the ignore dodge effect.
Damage over time based on ST, disappears after activation; Can Detonate to explode.
This type of bonus damage is dealt on top of attacks, is reduced by Evasion-type effects, and can be immune after a certain number of turns.
